divergences.upstreamResult: React Visx callbacks receive React synthetic events.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane Visx callbacks receive native DOM events.
divergences.rationale: Octane delegates native browser events without a synthetic wrapper.
divergences.consumerImpact: Callbacks have native event fields and no React synthetic lifecycle.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use native DOM event fields directly.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane introduces synthetic events.

divergences.upstreamResult: Several upstream controllers are React classes and Brush exposes a legacy innerRef instance.
divergences.octaneResult: Controllers and measurement lifecycles are functional hooks; Brush omits the legacy instance handle.
divergences.rationale: Octane does not expose React class instances.
divergences.consumerImpact: Consumers cannot use Brush innerRef as a class-controller escape hatch.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use public callbacks, state props, and DOM refs.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if upstream removes the legacy instance API.

divergences.upstreamResult: Text, annotation, path, and wordcloud layouts may depend on browser measurement or canvas packing.
divergences.octaneResult: Fixed-size layouts use deterministic estimates, SVG sampling, and collision-aware rectangles.
divergences.rationale: Deterministic output enables complete SSR and exact hydration adoption.
divergences.consumerImpact: Font-specific wrapping, path rounding, and pixel-exact d3-cloud packing can differ.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Provide explicit dimensions and validate font-sensitive layouts in the target browser.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when portable deterministic upstream measurement exists.

divergences.upstreamResult: The react-spring entry uses @react-spring/web and Zoom uses @use-gesture/react.
divergences.octaneResult: Animation uses deterministic requestAnimationFrame interpolation and Zoom uses native listeners.
divergences.rationale: React-owned animation and gesture runtimes cannot execute inside Octane components.
divergences.consumerImpact: Timing follows numeric interpolation rather than spring physics while props and final output remain compatible.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Do not depend on exact upstream spring timing curves.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when framework-neutral upstream adapters are available.

divergences.octaneResult: Renderable props accept Octane renderables while preserving render-prop parameter shapes.
divergences.rationale: Octane elements are nominal and are not assignable to React.ReactNode.
divergences.consumerImpact: Type signatures accept Octane elements rather than importing React node types.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Pass Octane renderables to visual content props.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if the upstream public types become framework-neutral.
